name: Marya Stark
reason: Mainly a recording and performing musician rather than a spiritual teacher: her own site (marya-stark.com) is an artist site of albums, films, lyrics and poetry with a management/booking inbox, and her about page on templeofthemuse.com says she expresses her work primarily through producing albums and performances. Her teaching offerings there are songwriting and vocal-craft bundles plus a women's 'Voice Of My Womb' journey whose current run began 13 October (already started). No Shift mention found. A human may disagree and list her (base Grass Valley, California; mgmt@marya-stark.com).
